ev.q: The overall death rate for teens aged 15–19 years, decreased 34.7% from 68.6 per 100,000 population in 1999 to 44.8 in 2013.
The overall death rate for teens aged 15–19 years, decreased 34.7% from 68.6 per 100,000 population in 1999 to 44.8 in 2013.
The rates in 2013 were 44.8 per 100,000 population overall, 62.3 for males, and 26.4 for females in the age group.
throughout the period rates were higher for males
The rate of decrease was about the same for both males and females
Source: CDC. Underlying cause of death 1999–2013. CDC WONDER.
